summary: Users switching between laptop and phone report overwritten habits and tasks during manual backup restore.
Tarteel AI gained massive traction with real-time Quran speech recognition, but requires full internet connection.
Vocabulary database in src/data/languages/vocabularyDatabase.ts is static (~1,200 words); users cannot import their own word lists or export to Anki.
Working professionals maintain corporate Google/Outlook calendars, causing task conflicts during prayer windows.
